description: Elections Commission - Notify the names of Mayors, Deputy Mayors, Chairmen & Vice Chairmen for the Colombo MC & 10 Other Local Bodies
reasoning: This gazette contains the official declaration of election results for local authorities, specifically naming appointed Mayors, Deputy Mayors, Chairmen, and Vice Chairmen for various municipal councils, urban councils, and pradeshiya sabhas. It is published under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and issued by the Election Commission, making it clearly about electoral processes and results.
